title: DisciplineTaxonomySpecification
description: Formal JSON Schema specification for the 55-discipline DeepTech taxonomy, domain boundaries, keywords, parent cluster groupings, and repository metrics in Github Ultimate Repos.

version.description: Semantic version identifier of the taxonomy specification

total_disciplines.description: Total count of granular DeepTech disciplines (strictly 55)

clusters.description: Hierarchical parent clusters grouping disciplines into macroscopic fields

disciplines.description: Comprehensive specification for each of the 55 disciplines

stable_id.description: Immutable kebab-case slug identifier for external linking and references

name.description: Canonical full title of the discipline as cataloged

slug.description: Filesystem and URL slug matching category documents

description.description: Comprehensive technical definition and scope of the discipline

parent_cluster.description: Identifier of the parent domain cluster

keywords.description: Core foundational search keywords, alternate names, and domain synonyms

top_languages.description: Most prominent programming languages represented in this discipline

repository_count.description: Verified repository count corresponding to starred_repos_master_catalog.csv

total_stars.description: Aggregate stargazer count for the discipline

total_forks.description: Aggregate fork count for the discipline

language_diversity.description: Count of distinct programming languages cataloged
